# The compiler's std privilege keys (TestCompilerReadsNoStdMembership; owner,
# 2026-11-12: the standard library gets no special treatment). One row per
# key, sorted: `category<TAB>file:function<TAB>kind<TAB>key<TAB>reason<TAB>unit`;
# kind is mark, flag, name, built, runtime or table, key a quoted Go string.
# go test ./internal/residue -run '^TestCompilerReadsNoStdMembership$' -write-privileges
# drops the rows no key names and sorts; it adds none. A debt row joins only
# through stdPrivilegesBaseline, a go-boundary row only through goBoundaryKeys
# (std_privileges_baseline_test.go).
